4387.title: SQLite credential lookup omitted from Go usage collector
4387.rootCauseOneLine: The Go usage collector reads Console accounts and legacy API-key sources but never reads active keys from the v2 credential table, returning unauthenticated before any usage request.
4387.proposedFix: Add a validated, read-only lookup for active v2 API keys, preserving existing credential precedence and excluding unrelated or inactive credentials. Cover key selection, malformed values, missing tables, and legacy behavior.
4387.caveats: Collector-level reproduction with a real synthetic SQLite database and mocked network only; no live service account, provider session, or hosted usage endpoint was exercised. No automatic fix: adding an authentication credential source fails this rule's simple-fix eligibility.
